name: Jane Doe
headline: Senior Software Engineer
about: Demo persona for the Beaconfolio portfolio template. Jane is a fictional senior software engineer with a decade of experience across backend platforms, cloud infrastructure, and modern web frontends. Replace this profile with your own via the admin panel (Profile Data upload) — no code changes needed.

projects.title: Beaconfolio
projects.summary: An open-source, recruiter-oriented portfolio template: fork it, drop in your content, and you are live.
projects.description:
A full-stack portfolio and blog with semantic search and a local LLM. Angular 22 with SSR on the front, FastAPI and PostgreSQL with pgvector behind it, the whole stack shipped as Docker images and deployed by a single push to main.

Everything a forker needs to change is content or configuration — never a component.

projects.title: Semantic Search Service
projects.summary: Embedding-backed search over a document corpus, answering in under 100ms at the 95th percentile.
projects.description: Chunking, embedding and approximate-nearest-neighbour retrieval over pgvector, with a small reranking pass in front of the results. Instrumented end to end so that a slow query names the stage that was slow.

projects.title: Pipeline Observability Dashboard
projects.summary: A build-pipeline dashboard that shows why a run was slow, not merely that it was.

recommendations.author: Alex Example
recommendations.text: This is a demo recommendation shipped with the Beaconfolio template. Jane consistently delivered reliable, well-tested systems and elevated the whole team's engineering standards. Replace it with your real recommendations via the admin Profile Data upload.

recommendations.author: Sam Sample
recommendations.text: A demo recommendation: Jane bridges product and engineering effortlessly — pragmatic architecture, clear communication, and shipping cadence you can plan a roadmap around.
